messages:
sam (product): Heads-up: Nova Realtime v1 is GA for Hosted API 🚀. Main points: unified multiplexed streams, JSON-first structured outputs, and builtin session budgets. Rolling to us-west-2 and eu-west-1 today; global rollout over 48h. Docs: https://redwood.example.com/nova-realtime-ga

ivy (eng-runtime): New stable endpoint: POST /v2/realtime/nova with header X-RW-Realtime: nova. Multiplexing uses connection_id + convo_id. Backcompat: /v1/realtime still works but won't get session budgets.

noel (devex): Quick example (curl):
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "X-RW-Realtime: nova" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"connection_id":"c-99","convo_id":"chat-7","model":"nova-13b"}' \
  https://api.redwood.com/v2/realtime/nova

build-bot: deploy finished  nova-realtime@stable at 2667771305 :white_check_mark:

maya (docs): Migration guide + parsers live: https://redwood.example.com/docs/nova-realtime-migrate. Note: structured responses include a top-level "__structured__" key; use SDK helpers to avoid brittle parsing.

tomas (eng-sre): Observability: Nova dashboards enabled. Default alerts: p95 latency > 500ms for 3m or error rate >1% for 5m. We'll pre-warm pools for nova-13b to reduce cold-starts.

sam (product): We'll publish a short customer blurb and host two office hours tomorrow 10am & 4pm PT for migrations. If you need extra runway for /v1 compatibility, file an eng-runtime ticket. Thanks team! :tada:
